T: Little did he know, there would be cookies.
D: A tax auditor starts hearing a voice narrating his life and learns he is about to die.
P: Serve the sweets when Ana brings Harold the cookies.
S: Harold's life run to the second
Ham and cheese toasties cooked for exactly three minutes a side and cut into precise triangles.
Harold turning up at Ana's bakery with a box of flours

Crisp-edged, chewy butter cookies made with plain, spelt and rye flour and browned butter, rolled in demerara sugar and finished with flaky salt. Brown 150g butter until nutty and cool 10 minutes. Whisk with 100g brown sugar, 50g caster sugar, 1 egg and 1 tsp vanilla. Stir in 100g plain flour, 60g spelt flour, 40g rye flour, 1 tsp baking powder and a pinch of salt. Chill 30 minutes. Heat the oven to 180C. Roll into 16 balls, roll in demerara sugar and bake 11 to 12 minutes. Sprinkle with flaky salt while warm.
M: a night in after another audit
Chicken and leek pot pie under puff pastry, the kind of dinner a careful man counts the bites of.
W: Ana's warm skillet cookie with ice cream
the warm cookies Ana bakes for Harold, little did he know

A giant chocolate chip cookie baked in a cast-iron pan until golden at the edges and gooey in the middle, topped with vanilla ice cream and hot fudge. Heat the oven to 180C. Beat 125g soft butter with 100g brown sugar and 50g caster sugar, then 1 egg and 1 tsp vanilla. Stir in 180g plain flour, half a tsp bicarb, a pinch of salt and 150g chopped dark chocolate. Press into a buttered 23cm ovenproof frying pan and bake 18 to 20 minutes until golden at the edges but soft in the middle. Rest 5 minutes, top with 4 scoops of vanilla ice cream and drizzle with hot fudge sauce.
K: a cold glass of milk to go with Ana's cookies

Ice-cold full cream milk whisked with malted milk powder, vanilla bean and a little honey until frothy, poured into tall frosted glasses. Put 4 tall glasses in the freezer for 20 minutes. Scrape the seeds from half a vanilla bean into a jug. Add 4 tbsp malted milk powder, 1 tbsp honey and 100ml milk and whisk into a smooth paste. Add 900ml very cold full cream milk and whisk hard, or blend for 20 seconds, until frothy. Pour into the frosted glasses and dust with a little more malt.
